Description
 Join a global, cross-functional team building an enterprise insurance product with integrated e-billing functionality.
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Network Security Engineer to scale and secure our infrastructure. You will drive cloud network automation across AWS and Azure, enhance system reliability, and automate day-to-day operations.
 Requirements
 Must Have:
Next-gen firewall administration and configuration (Palo Alto preferred)
WAF administration (Barracuda SaaS preferred; other top-tier vendors considered)
Azure networking: VNets, UDRs, ExpressRoute, vWAN, API Management networking, hub-and-spoke
AWS networking: VPCs, Transit Gateway, ALB/NLB, Direct Connect, Route 53, VPC endpoints, hub-and-spoke
Network design and architecture experience
Scripting: Terraform, Bash, Python, Azure/AWS CLI, PowerShell
 Nice to Have:
Routing
Swiching
ACI
SD-WAN
WI-FI
 Job responsibilities
Support and develop existing network management solution with modern security practices.
Participate in designing, automation and securing of hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN/Direct Connect) between AWS, Azure, and datacenter systems.
Partner closely with DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to ensure network architecture meets product security and scaling requirements.
Implement proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and enforcement of security baselines.
